info.title: ReconVault API
info.description: Executes HTTP requests on demand and records every request and response in PostgreSQL for browsing, per-domain aggregation and full-field secret search. Every /api/v1 endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Errors use the `Error` envelope. See docs/API.md for details.

servers.description: Same origin: the docker compose entrypoint serves the API under /api/v1

tags.name: Artifacts
tags.description: Browse, search and delete recorded artifacts.

tags.name: Recon
tags.description: Read-only views of the domains and dns_records tables populated by reconvault-dns-autoscan.

post.summary: Execute an HTTP request and record it
post.description: Sends the request and stores request and response as an artifact. Redirects are not followed; no compression is negotiated; requests to non-public addresses are refused (SSRF protection, checked on the resolved IP). Transport failures after the request was attempted are recorded with null response fields and reported as 502/504 with `artifact_id`. Validation failures and blocked destinations are not recorded. TLS certificate errors are always ignored: self-signed, expired, untrusted and hostname-mismatched certificates and TLS 1.0/1.1 servers are recorded like any other target.

request_headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/134.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

example.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 16
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 12:30:00 GMT

{"success":true}

403.description: The target resolves to a non-public address.

error.message: the target resolves to a non-public address, which is not allowed
request body must not exceed 2097152 bytes

502.description: The target could not be reached (DNS, connection, TLS handshake, protocol). The attempt is recorded.

504.description: The target did not respond within UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT. The attempt is recorded.

get.summary: List artifacts (sorting, hostname filter, cursor pagination)
get.description: Keyset pagination: when `meta.next_cursor` is non-null, pass it as `cursor` to get the next page. The cursor carries sort_by, sort_order and hostname; explicit values that contradict it are rejected. Ties are broken by `id` in the same direction; NULLs sort last for ASC and first for DESC.

get.summary: Case-insensitive substring search across all fields
get.description: Matches every column, including request headers (keys and values), request body and the raw response (response headers and body). `%`, `_` and `\` are matched literally. Results are newest first and contain metadata only.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keyword: 1-1024 bytes of UTF-8, not blank, no control characters.

get.summary: Get one artifact with all fields

example.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 16
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 12:30:00 GMT

{"success":true}

delete.description: Removes the row from http_artifacts. There is no soft delete and no restore.

get.description: Ties are ordered by hostname ASC.
Returns the `domains` row for the hostname (case-insensitive). `asn`, `asn_name` and `waf` are null while unknown.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Hostname, trimmed and lower-cased; 1-255 characters, no control characters.

404.description: The hostname has not been scanned.

get.summary: Complete DNS history for one hostname
get.description: Every stored record version, unpaginated, newest first (updated_at DESC, then record_type, record_value). An unknown hostname yields an empty list.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Hostname, trimmed and lower-cased; 1-255 characters, no control characters.

get.summary: Distinct hostnames under a root domain
get.description: Sorted by hostname ASC, unpaginated. `meta.total` always equals the length of `data`.

parameters.name: root_domain
parameters.description: Root domain, trimmed and lower-cased; 1-255 characters, no control characters.

get.summary: Root domains with unique hostname counts
get.description: Ordered by hostname_count DESC, then root_domain ASC.

bearerAuth.description: The API_KEY configured on the server (at least 32 characters).

artifact_id.description: ID of the recorded failed attempt (upstream errors only).

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL; host at most 253 characters. Must resolve to a public address unless ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=true.

headers.description: Header name to value. Names must be RFC 9110 tokens and unique case-insensitively; values must not contain control characters (tab allowed). If User-Agent is absent or empty, the default `Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/134.0.0.0 Safari/537.36` is sent. `Host` overrides the Host header.

Artifact.description: A recorded request/response exchange (every column of http_artifacts).

requested_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, up to microsecond precision.

response_status_code.description: Null when the request failed before a response.

response_body_size_bytes.description: Raw size of the response body; the declared Content-Length when the body was truncated.

request_headers.description: Headers actually sent, including the default User-Agent.

example.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/134.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

response.example:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 16
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 12:30:00 GMT

{"success":true}
response.description: Raw HTTP response: status line, all response headers (canonical names, sorted), blank line, body (at most MAX_RESPONSE_BODY_BYTES), CRLF line endings. Invalid UTF-8 and NUL bytes are replaced with U+FFFD. Artifacts recorded before migration 0004 contain the body only.

response_body_truncated.description: True when the response body exceeded MAX_RESPONSE_BODY_BYTES and was truncated.

requested_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, up to microsecond precision.

SearchResult.description: Artifact metadata; fetch headers and bodies with GET /api/v1/http/artifacts/{id}.

requested_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, up to microsecond precision.

last_requested_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, up to microsecond precision.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

waf.description: null when WAF detection has not produced a result.

error.message: limit: must be an integer between 1 and 100

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error. Details are logged, never returned.
